svg.aria-label: Recall architecture: camera RTSP to one decoded NV12 timeline on the SiMa.ai Modalix DevKit, branched to H.264 VideoSender, yolo26m-seg, yolo26m-pose and a 1 fps JPEG ring; deterministic object tracker, wrist attribution and events into SQLite; GenAI lane with a single-flight LLiMa server running Qwen3-VL and Whisper, Namer, Answerer, Summarizer and Piper; FastAPI on 8090 serving an air-gapped browser UI on 8080 and Insight viewer on 8081. Everything stays on the local link.
svg.text: Recall — edge visual memory on SiMa.ai Modalix
camera → MLA masks + pose → deterministic identity & events → SQLite → local VLM / ASR / TTS → air-gapped UI
LOCAL LINK ONLY — INTERNET CABLE CAN BE UNPLUGGED
SiMa.ai Modalix DevKit · MLSoC · < 10 W · no cloud
PyNeat graph · LLiMa :9998 · SQLite · FastAPI :8090 · Piper
retry once · cached by track id
SQL rows + JPEG files → read routes
